hints.title: Pick a useful corner
hints.body: A full scan repeats work. Which corner lets a single comparison discard an entire row or an entire column?

hints.title: The top-right corner
hints.body: At the top-right cell, every value to the left is no larger and every value below is no smaller. A comparison therefore points in exactly one direction.

hints.title: Shrink the remaining table
hints.body: Keep the search inside a rectangle. If the current value is too large, move left; if it is too small, move down. Each move removes one row or one column.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
row = 0
col = last column
while row < rowCount and col >= 0:
    value = matrix[row][col]
    if value == target: return true
    if value > target: col = col - 1
    else: row = row + 1
return false
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
